name: Extra Kyubi Trick
body:
Your magical tails grant you more kyubi tricks then most kitsune of comparable ability.

Prerequisite: Kyubi Awakening, Magical Tail, character level 3rd, change shape racial trait, kitsune.

Benefit: You gain an additional kyubi trick.

You must meet the kyubi trick’s prerequisites, including the required number of Magical Tail feats.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times.

Racial Prestige: Kyubi Paragon © 2016 by Everyman Gaming, LLC
